heuristics.note: HEURISTIC. Rejects model text containing the active or a remaining guided step's answer as a standalone number, number word, equivalent polynomial span or the key option's text. The word "one" used as a determiner or pronoun ("one way", "on one side") is not read as the value 1 unless a value cue precedes it ("x is one"). Paraphrases (e.g. "dividing by 3" for the option "Divide by 3") are not detected.
Learner-facing model text that mentions the host or keys is rejected and repaired (word match on "host", "key", "keys").

Each guided step names the skill it exercises (the repair skill or a declared prerequisite); being stuck at the smallest step checks that prerequisite directly (Round 2 ruling 8). The tags are authored per template, not inferred.
HEURISTIC. Model text may not contain "?"; the only question shown is the host-rendered item prompt.
Deterministic value matching of known error patterns. A match is recorded as an observation, never a confirmed cause, and only selects the probe/descent branch.
